title: The $1M ARR channel map.
description: Every channel B2B startups use to get from zero to $1M ARR, with how fast each one moves, what it costs, and three things to do this week to get it going.
formHeader: 15 channels. Three first steps for each.
formEyebrow: Get it free, in your inbox
disclosure: You will also get The Draft, one letter a week on how top 1% startups crush organic marketing. Leave whenever you like.

blocks.text: Founders who reach $1M ARR almost always get there on two or three channels, worked properly for a long time. Picking which ones is the hard part.
I'm a partner at RallyUp. We pivoted to an agency on 1 May 2026 with almost nothing, and we've grown every month since. I wish we'd had this map on day one.

items: All 15 channels, from programmatic SEO to warm intros
How fast each one moves and what it really costs
Three things to do this week to get each one going
The mistake that usually kills each channel
How to pick your two, and how long to give them

blocks.text: One caveat: the speed and cost labels are my rules of thumb from running these for founders, and nobody measured them as benchmarks. Use the map to choose, then judge every channel on the customers it brings in.
